high_level_description: stc brand style, a modern web interface design mockup for a video streaming platform.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A white background with subtle shadows creating a 3D overlapping effect.

elements.desc: A purple and pink interface mockup showing a movie title header, a play button, navigation menu, and a grid of video thumbnails with purple play buttons.
A secondary panel on the right with purple and white sections containing navigation icons and video playback controls.
